name: iam:PassRole + elasticmapreduce:RunJobFlow
description: Create an EMR cluster with a privileged IAM instance profile as the JobFlowRole. An EMR step using command-runner.jar executes on the master node, which has access to the instance profile credentials via IMDS, and calls iam:AttachUserPolicy to escalate the starting principal to administrative access. The cluster auto-terminates after the step.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must be able to pass both the EC2 instance profile role and the EMR service role

additional.description: Poll cluster state to confirm execution

admin: IAM role that can be used as an EC2 instance profile (trusts ec2.amazonaws.com) with administrative permissions
IAM role that can serve as the EMR service role (trusts elasticmapreduce.amazonaws.com)
The AWSServiceRoleForEMRCleanup service-linked role must exist in the account
lateral: A role that can be used as an EC2 instance profile with elevated permissions
A role that can serve as the EMR service role

references.title: Configure IAM service roles for Amazon EMR

options.name: INSTANCE_PROFILE
options.description: Admin IAM instance profile name to pass as the EMR JobFlowRole (the EC2 master node assumes this role)

options.name: SERVICE_ROLE
options.description: EMR service role name to pass as the ServiceRole (trusts elasticmapreduce.amazonaws.com)

options.name: TARGET_ARN
options.description: IAM user or role name/ARN to escalate (auto-detected from current identity if not set)

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for the EMR cluster

options.name: INSTANCE_TYPE
options.description: EC2 instance type for the master node

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Terminate cluster if it is still running after execution (clusters auto-terminate via --auto-terminate)

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess policy to an IAM user or role via an EMR step command
